subject: dsa
title: Reverse Integer
summary: Pop the last digit with x % 10 and push it onto result = result * 10 + digit, shrinking x by /10. Check the 32-bit limit before each push and return 0 on overflow.
problem: Reverse the digits of a 32-bit signed integer, returning 0 if the reversed value overflows.

steps.caption: Reverse the digits of 123. Repeatedly pop the last digit and push it onto the result. Here are the input digits.
Pop the last digit 3. It becomes the first digit of the result, so result = 3.
Each push checks 321 against the 32-bit max of about 2.1 billion. A value that would exceed it returns 0 instead of overflowing.
No overflow, so the reversed result is 321.
